title: Multi-Start Differential Evolution with Dual Initialization Patterns (36-Layer)
scientific_hypothesis: A multi-start initialization strategy combining proven uniform baseline (100 nm) with deliberately phase-shifted quartet patterns (50/150 nm alternating pairs) will enable Differential Evolution to escape the destructive-interference valley observed in rounds 4-6, recovering or exceeding the round-1 best_target_score of 0.9275 by probing adjacent constructive interference peaks.
design_principle: Population-based optimization with heterogeneous initialization seeds 50% of candidates at the proven R1 uniform baseline to anchor search stability, and 50% at phase-shifted quartet patterns to explicitly probe alternative interference configurations that gradient-based methods may miss.
proposed_topology: 36-layer alternating Ta2O5/SiO2 stack on fused silica substrate, air incidence, starting with Ta2O5 as layer 1
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack optimization principles from evidence showing alternating high-low index layers enable broadband suppression
Population-based optimization strategies for multi-modal search landscapes
expected_advantages: Differential Evolution's population diversity prevents premature convergence to local optima
Dual initialization patterns explicitly probe both proven baseline and alternative interference configurations
May recover round-1 performance while maintaining manufacturable thickness range
known_risks: Population-based methods require more function evaluations per round
Phase-shifted patterns may not align with optimal interference conditions for this specific band configuration
36-layer complexity may still exhibit numerical convergence issues
execution_request_english: Optimize a 36-layer Ta2O5/SiO2 dielectric filter on fused silica substrate with air incidence at 0 degrees, unpolarized light. Layer sequence: Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2, Ta2O5, SiO2 (36 layers total, alternating starting with Ta2O5). All layer thicknesses bounded between 20 nm and 350 nm. Use Differential Evolution optimizer with population size 20. Initialize 50% of population (10 candidates) with all layers at 100.0 nm uniform thickness. Initialize remaining 50% (10 candidates) with alternating quartet pattern: layers 1-4 at [50, 150, 50, 150] nm repeating for all 36 layers. Spectral simulation range 300-1200 nm with 1 nm resolution. Target bands: maximize transmittance in 420-700 nm band, minimize transmittance in 355-365 nm band, minimize transmittance in 1030-1080 nm band, minimize transmittance at 355 nm single wavelength. Report best_target_score, valid_candidates count, tightest_margin, and thicknesses_nm for all valid candidates. Canonical user controls: incidence angles 0 degrees. polarization unpolarized. wavelength intervals 355-355 nm, 355-365 nm, 420-700 nm, 1030-1080 nm. soft objectives: high average transmittance in 420-700 nm; low average transmittance at 355 nm; low average transmittance in 355-365 nm; low average transmittance in 1030-1080 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high transmittance at 355 nm; high transmittance in 355-365 nm; high transmittance in 1030-1080 nm; high loss in 420-700 nm. manufacturing constraints: maximum 36 layers; layer thickness range 20-350 nm.
revision_reason: Direct implementation of feedback directive: multi-start stochastic initialization with 50/50 split between uniform baseline and phase-shifted quartet patterns, paired with Differential Evolution optimizer to force structural diversification and escape the destructive-interference valley observed in rounds 4-6.
